description: Defines a template class 'segmented_sib_list' for managing multiple SIB messages in segmented form, including methods for accessing, appending, and iterating over segments.

classes.name: segmented_sib_list
classes.description: A template class that manages a list of SIB message segments, allowing access, iteration, and management of segmented SIB data.

methods.name: get_current_segment
methods.description: Returns a reference to the current SIB segment buffer.

methods.name: get_segment
methods.description: Returns a read-only or mutable reference to a specified SIB segment buffer.

methods.name: advance_current_segment
methods.description: Advances the current segment index, wrapping around if necessary.

methods.name: get_segment_length
methods.description: Returns the length of a specified SIB segment.

methods.name: append_segment
methods.description: Appends a new SIB segment buffer to the list.

methods.name: get_nof_segments
methods.description: Returns the total number of stored SIB segments.
